rigs.R15: the player's own avatar; clips bind by part name, so they play on any R15 body

ElderRig.kind: rigid Motor6D rig of MeshParts driven by an AnimationController; no skinning needed

priorities: Idles pose arms, torso and head only (body: upper) at Idle priority, looped: the weapon carry survives walking and the default Animate walk drives the legs. Moves are Action, hit reactions Action2, grabs Action3. Check per fighter in a playtest: stand, walk, run, jump, land, and watch the legs.

weapons.Wagasa: Closed umbrella held by the handle at the side, ferrule DOWN near the ground like a walking cane at rest; in a strike the tip leads a thrust or the shaft swings like a short staff; never held by the canopy.
weapons.WagasaOpen: Open canopy faces the threat, shaft pointing at the attacker and held two-handed at chest height so the canopy covers head and torso.
weapons.TaikoBachi: One stick per hand, gripped near the butt end; ready stance has both sticks raised in front of and above the head, elbows high; strikes come straight down from overhead with the whole arm and a wrist snap, tips leading.
weapons.Bare hands (Iwao): No weapon: a low wide stance, knees bent, hips low, open palms forward at chest height; the hips drive every thrust; shiko raises one straight leg high to the side, then stamps.
weapons.Jitte: Gripped by the handle with the hook toward the thumb and up; at rest hook-up at the waist; strikes are short baton blows with the tip leading; the catch traps a hit between shaft and hook with the shaft angled up across the body.
weapons.WeightedChain: Coiled in the off hand at the hip; thrown sidearm from the left hand, weight leading.
weapons.FerryOar: A long oar used two-handed like a staff, hands shoulder-width apart, blade end higher and forward; at rest carried over the shoulder with the blade UP and behind; the blade leads every sweep and the shaft crosses in front of the body, never hanging at the feet.

markers: Marker times are the contact frames. The server's move timing in the Fighters data uses the same numbers, so a hit lands when the clip connects.
routes: Planned route: roblox-animation (author FK spec -> Blender render and contact sheet -> to_roblox.py -> KeyframeSequences). Blocked today: Blender is not installed. Pre-authorised fallback: author the poses as CFrame keys in a Poses module (as Tidebell does) and build the KeyframeSequences in Studio with execute_luau; still judged against each _intent sentence.
